tools.name: loc8id_create
tools.description: Create an actual Loc8ID in the authenticated user's Loc8ID account. Use this whenever the user asks to create, save, pin, bookmark, or generate a Loc8ID for a real place. Never construct a loc8id.com/... URL yourself — always call this tool so the location is actually saved to the user's account.

tools.name: loc8id_create_many
tools.description: Create multiple actual Loc8IDs in the authenticated user's account in one call. Use this instead of calling loc8id_create repeatedly when the user asks to save several places at once (e.g. "save these eight landmarks"). Returns which ones succeeded and which failed — a failure on one location does n

tools.name: loc8id_get
tools.description: Look up an existing Loc8ID by its short code, custom alias, or a pasted loc8id.com URL. Read-only — does not modify anything. Works for any public Loc8ID, not just the caller's own.

tools.name: loc8id_search
tools.description: Search the authenticated user's own Loc8IDs by short code, custom alias, name, or description. Results are returned most recently created first. Read-only.

tools.name: loc8id_update
tools.description: Update the name and/or description of a Loc8ID owned by the authenticated user. Omitted fields remain unchanged. This never changes the coordinates or short code.

tools.name: collection_create
tools.description: Create a new (private by default) collection in the authenticated user's account. Use this when the user asks to group locations together, e.g. "put these in a collection called...". A Pro-plan feature — fails with a clear plan_required error on a free account.

tools.name: collection_get
tools.description: Retrieve a collection and its Loc8IDs, by name or by ID. Use this when the user asks to see an existing collection, e.g. "show me my Ontario Trips collection". Read-only.

tools.name: collection_add_loc8id
tools.description: Add one or more existing Loc8IDs (by their short code) to a collection, given the collection's name or ID. Use this after loc8id_create/loc8id_create_many when the user wants the new locations filed into a collection. Adding a Loc8ID you don't own to your collection is a Pro feature.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "loc8id_create" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
